web_search.description: Search the web (Vietnamese and English) and get up to 10 results, each with title, URL and a snippet. Use it for current or external facts: regulations, prices, news, product docs, error messages, examples. After searching, read the 1-3 most relevant results with fetch_page before answering, and cite the URLs you used. Keep the query short (keywords, at most about 12 words) and never put personal data, passwords or file contents in it.

recent.description: only results from this period (for news or recent changes)

fetch_page.description: Download one public web page (http/https) and return its main text (headings, lists, tables), to read a search result in full. Does not run JavaScript, cannot open PDFs, images or pages that need a login. Never put personal data or file contents in the URL.

url.description: full http(s) address, usually taken from web_search results
